in_hebrew.name: Culley
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Dweller by the cool spring
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Culley הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English 'cuel' meaning 'cool' and 'leah' meaning 'wood, clearing'. This name was given to someone who lived by a cool spring or in a shady, peaceful clearing.

in_greek.name: Culley
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Dweller by the cool spring
in_greek.long_meaning: Culley είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Old English 'cuel' meaning 'cool' and 'leah' meaning 'wood, clearing'. This name was given to someone who lived by a cool spring or in a shady, peaceful clearing.

in_latin.name: Culley
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Dweller by the cool spring
in_latin.long_meaning: Culley est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Old English 'cuel' meaning 'cool' and 'leah' meaning 'wood, clearing'. This name was given to someone who lived by a cool spring or in a shady, peaceful clearing.
